title: Account Suspension Urgency Lure
description: Scammers send urgent account suspension notices mimicking financial or payment services (e.g. PayPal, Chase) with countdown timers or immediate verification links to credential harvesting pages.

title: Document Sharing & Invoice Phishing
description: Attacker impersonates DocuSign, Dropbox, or OneDrive sharing an encrypted or overdue invoice, directing victims to fake OAuth or login portals.

title: Shipping & Package Delivery Impersonation
description: Notifications pretending to be DHL, FedEx, or UPS claiming a package is delayed or unpaid customs fee required, linking to malicious payment forms.

title: Double Extension Malware Delivery
description: Emails containing malicious attachments disguised as PDFs or documents using double extensions such as .pdf.exe or .docx.scr.

title: Unauthenticated Display Name Impersonation
description: VIP or executive impersonation where the display name states the executive or CEO but the sender address is a free webmail or spoofed unauthenticated domain lacking SPF/DKIM/DMARC.

title: Payroll & Direct Deposit Redirection
description: Urgent requests targeting HR/finance claiming employee bank direct deposit details need immediate verification or updating before pay cycle deadline.

title: Cloud Storage Shared Link Phishing
description: Google Drive or SharePoint notifications linking to external credential harvesting pages mimicking Microsoft 365 or Google login screens.

title: Tax Authority / Government Refund Scam
description: Notices claiming an unclaimed tax rebate or penalty notice requiring immediate identity card number and banking PIN submission.

title: IT Helpdesk Password Expiry Notice
description: Fake internal IT alerts stating user password expires today and directing to fake self-service password reset portals on unauthorized domains.

title: Voicemail / Audio Message Attachment Lure
description: Notification claiming missed urgent voice message with an attached audio file disguised as .wav.vbs or .mp3.exe.

title: E-Commerce Order Cancellation & Refund
description: Fake Amazon or Apple purchase confirmations with unauthorized charge alerts urging customer to call fake numbers or click cancellation links.

title: Macro-Enabled Invoice Dropper
description: Supplier invoice emails attaching .docm or .xlsm files prompting victims to enable macros to view protected content.

title: Suspicious TLD Redirection Campaign
description: Phishing emails leveraging high-abuse free TLDs (.tk, .ml, .xyz) to host transient credential harvesting landing pages.

title: Bank KYC Re-Verification Alert
description: Banking alerts claiming mandatory KYC re-verification is pending and accounts will be frozen without instant document upload.

title: Shortened URL Obfuscation Lure
description: Phishing links disguised using link shorteners (bit.ly, tinyurl) to bypass basic gateway URL filtering and hide malicious landing servers.

title: Lookalike Brand Subdomain Trick
description: Hostnames embedding trusted names into subdomains (e.g. appleid.verify-session.biz) to deceive users who only glance at the start of URLs.

title: Reply-To Redirection Exfiltration
description: Phishing emails using legitimate display addresses in the From field while setting Reply-To to an attacker-controlled external domain.

title: Unauthenticated Free Webmail Executive Spoof
description: Emails sent from Gmail/Yahoo free addresses with display names mimicking corporate leadership requesting urgent gift cards or wire transfers.

title: Multi-Hop Relay Anomaly Phish
description: Spam campaigns routed through open relays across multiple suspicious hops to conceal original sending infrastructure.

title: New Domain Registration Campaign
description: Targeted spear-phishing using domains registered less than 30 days prior to evade age-based domain reputation blocklists.

title: Subscription Auto-Renewal Charge Alert
description: Fake Norton/GeekSquad invoices claiming $499 auto-renewal will process in 2 hours unless customer calls or fills cancellation link.

title: Cryptocurrency Wallet Verification Scam
description: Fake alerts from MetaMask or Coinbase demanding wallet seed phrase confirmation to avoid account deactivation.

title: Fake Survey & Gift Card Incentive
description: Targeted phishing offering high-value shopping vouchers in exchange for logging in with work credentials.

title: HR Benefit Enrollment Deadline Scam
description: Fake HR notices stating open enrollment closes today with links to external spoofed benefit portals.

title: Law Enforcement Subpoena Notice Lure
description: Scare-tactic emails claiming recipient is named in a court case and must download and execute an attached case archive.

title: Raw IP Address Host Phish
description: Phishing emails with verification URLs pointing directly to raw numerical IPv4 addresses instead of registered domain names.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication Reset Lure
description: Fake alerts claiming MFA device was deregistered and prompting user to authenticate on a spoofed identity provider.

title: Compromised Vendor Invoice Update
description: Emails claiming supplier changed banking accounts, providing updated routing details in a macro-enabled spreadsheet.

title: DMARC Authentication Failure Spoof
description: Forged brand sender addresses that fail domain cryptographic verification and SPF SPF/DKIM validation.

title: Typosquat Payment Gateway Re-Route
description: Domains visually imitating payment processors (e.g. str1pe, paypa1) used to intercept merchant transactions.
